candidate.title: STRT
candidate.scope: The middle STRT row of the assigned Illumina crop, associated by its listed citation with Islam et al. (2011), at schematic rather than complete experimental implementation scope. Three separately processed cell examples receive indices through the depicted oligo(dT)/cytosine-tail/template-switch route, then converge into a pooled library and cell-resolved sequence output. The CEL-Seq row above and TCR Chain Pairing row below are separately labeled neighboring workflows, without a depicted alternative or material connection to STRT, and are excluded. The expansion Single-cell tagged reverse transcription is the caption for STRT, not a second method. Only supplied publication metadata and abstracts have been inspected; reaction architecture comes from the image.
